sourcePorts.head: 88de16913acd4f464ec523667dce71ab71fa0e02
sourcePorts.scope: Only the shared centering stylesheet, its two imports, and the general empty-chat class were ported. Current menu, default background and navigation behavior retained.

changes: Animated WebGL homepage with 11 course worlds and five assistant comets; interactive notes, classroom, problems, memory and calendar examples.
Public examples use an isolated local database; authenticated grading is disabled in the showcase.
Empty chats show the ocean background by default; removed the toggle. Background hides for existing conversations.
Course tools menu replaces materials with upload, adds classroom and removes publishing settings. Top tabs retain chat, problems, notes, progress and memory.
Global Home button continues opening chat. Only the Syntara wordmark navigates to the animated public homepage.
Browser session checking deduplicates in-flight requests, has a 12-second timeout and offers retry.
Read-only local staging preview verifies its source baseline and defaults to the deployed homepage.
General and course empty chats share centered layouts across viewport widths; removed conflicting desktop grid rules.

validation.pythonPublicRunner: ran both bundled tests; stub returned None, as expected
liveBrowser: Authenticated App restored existing course data without an auth hang.
Top learning tabs contained chat, problems, notes, progress and memory.
Course tools menu contained upload and classroom, with no publishing settings.
Global Home returned from the classroom list to chat.
Empty chat had one ocean canvas and no toggle; measured group and available center both 388px at 1280px width.
Clicking the wordmark opened the animated homepage at the staging root.
Public homepage notes example loaded eight notebooks.
validation.predeployStderr: Prisma upgrade notice only; no pending migrations.

limitations: No new real course edits, classroom starts, or student submissions were performed during this deployment acceptance.
Local network requests to Railway intermittently timed out earlier; the final source and authenticated read checks succeeded.
Homepage fallback and mobile layout were checked locally; final online acceptance used the desktop browser.
